optimizedDescription.value: SchemaRegistry port: resolve/resolveRaw/list with npm, workspace, and path prefix routing.

optimizedContext.value:
# SchemaRegistry

## Rules
- Interface (not abstract): `resolve`, `resolveRaw`, `list`. Ctor: `ReadonlyMap<string, SchemaRepository>`.
- `resolve(ref) → Promise<Schema|null>`. Routing: `@scope/name` → node_modules schema.yaml; `#workspace:name` → SchemaRepository; `#name`/bare → default workspace; fs path → direct. No multi-strategy fallback. Missing workspace repo → null. Caller maps null→SchemaNotFoundError.
- `resolveRaw(ref) → Promise<SchemaRawResult|null>`: data SchemaYamlData, templates map, resolvedPath (cycle detect). Same routing. For ResolveSchema merge pipeline.
- `list() → SchemaEntry[]` — discover only, no load/validate. Group: workspaces (declaration order) then npm. Entry: ref, name, source npm|workspace, workspace? if workspace.
- Re-export Schema from domain value-object.

## Constraints
- application/ports/; no I/O at port level. Schema defined in domain, re-exported here.
